title: Azusawa Kohane — A Secret Between Us〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's so cool...!
You can make the fireworks in the background move!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for teaching me this, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I take it your album's coming along well?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is! And I'd like to try doing the rest on my own from here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I really hope An likes it.)
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for agreeing to meet with me. I know you're busy helping out right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you're fine! Things are finally starting to calm down, so you don't have anything to worry about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what is it that you wanted to show me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember how we all went to Phoenix Wonderland together the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I put together a digital album using all the photos I took.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A digital album?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you can see it on your phone. That way, we don't have to print out anything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And it's easy to share too.
I'll send you it right now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, got it!
Okay... Download.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It should start playing on its own, so if you don't mind just letting it go for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure!
Oh, it's starting...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. This one!
From when we were at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You were so surprised when your order came.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was so much more than I expected. But it was good, so it ended up being worth it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There should be one of you eating it too. Oh, I think it's this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I look way too happy eating this thing! It's pretty embarrassing now that there's evidence of me doing this too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it moved to the next one!
Huh? What's with all these stars and flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everything's digital so it's easy to add stickers and stamps like these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some of them can sparkle and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's really cute! You did an amazing job with these! Wait, this looks like it took a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not really. My dad showed me how, so it ended up being pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it took me longer to choose which photos would go into this album...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, there were just so many good ones!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That means these are the best of the best in your opinion, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, the night show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...?
Why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because the photos of the fireworks from the night show are about to appear. Look closely...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, here we go... What the?!
The fireworks in the back are moving! How?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My dad showed me how to do this too, and I spent some time getting it to do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't have time to get the sound to work, but I think I got them to fire off right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's like a movie at this point!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But now I get why you were grinning the way you were. This was what you wanted to show me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's right.
It might even be the best part of this album.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm glad she likes it so much. It was really worth the effort.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, that was great...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You sent this to Haruka and Minori too, right? I'm sure they'll love it as much as I did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is actually just for you and me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this album was mostly just photos of us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I made a separate one like this for Minori and Haruka, and another one for all four of us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So it's really our special album?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you made them for all of us? That had to take forever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it really didn't! I had a lot of fun putting them together, and I'm hoping that we all get to keep enjoying these memories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But at the same time, you doing all the giving doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Dad! Can I give Kohane some extra cream and caramel sauce on the house?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! No, you don't have to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nonsense. I won't rest until you do, alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay... In that case, I accept. Thanks...
